subject: S12af done: page-wide probe (continuations + own microtasks, negatives fail), page-wide slab/parked budgets, clock-aware gate; restore decode() jank fixed; CI 44009928102 all green
body:
S12af done. Commits on claude/naadi-shared: 38eab56, 0fd7257, 46c0394 (lint).
CI run 44009928102 (46c0394): every job green, all 3 browsers. https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/44009928102

(1) Timing the async continuations, and microtasks
- The probe is page-wide: packages/ink/src/probe.ts, inkProbe.
- What it times:
  - every engine callback (scroll, frame, resize, settle timer)
  - the settle encode and decode .then continuations
  - the encode worker's onmessage and the toBlob callback
- A callback's time is its own run plus the microtasks it queued. A marker microtask is queued before the callback and a closing one after it. Microtasks queued earlier by someone else are not counted. Nested timed callbacks count once.
- Each sample carries a kind (scroll, resize, frame, settle, encode, decode). The e2e records the ms per kind, in total and in frames of 2 ms or more.
- Unit tests: probe.test.ts, 5 tests.
- Negative e2e checks, laptop profiles, each with 12 ms added at runtime. The gate fails when p95 reaches 2 ms:

| Regression | Chromium p95 | WebKit p95 |
|---|---|---|
| In the scroll handler | 12.5-13.4 ms | 12.5-13 ms |
| In a microtask the handler queues | 12.3-12.8 ms | 12.5-13 ms |

  The microtask case previously escaped at ratio 0.79.
- Real bug found by the breakdown: restoring a parked slab called img.decode(). WebKit runs decode() on the main thread in a later task: 85-106 ms per 8 Mpx picture (measured), while the student scrolls. Restore now shows the picture at once with decoding="async". Settling, which runs while the page is idle, keeps decode().

| dpr-2 tall page, scroll-handler time | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Total | ~1,700 ms | 86 ms |
| Frame max | 101-165 ms | 4-5 ms |

- The CI failure on 38eab56 (dpr-2 engine p95 = 2 ms, run 44000690930) is fixed by this and by (3).

(2) Page-wide picture caps
- MAX_SLABS_PIXELS (16 Mpx) and MAX_PARKED_BYTES (48 MB) are page-wide budgets: slabBudget and parkedPictureBudget, CanvasBudget instances exported from @naadi/ink.
- Visible slabs are pinned. An off-screen slab is created only if it fits, so surfaces do not take turns evicting each other.
- Over the bound, the least recently used off-screen slab, or the least recently parked picture, of any surface goes first.
- The 12-surface e2e asserts both page-wide peaks stay within their limits.

(3) Timer resolution
- WebKit's performance.now() moves in 1 ms steps; Chromium's in 0.1 ms. A frame sums two or three samples, so a frame with 0.3 ms of real work can read 2 ms.
- The gate measures the page's clock step. Where it is above 0.5 ms, the p95 is taken over 4-frame means; rounding errors are unbiased, and sustained work still shows in full.
- Both figures are recorded, with a note in the gate comment.

Local runs (--retries=0, 2 workers, rebased):
- smoke-19 and smoke-20: 70 passed each (14 skipped: they need the auth container).
- perf-19 and perf-20: 8 passed each.
- dpr-2, 4 repeat runs: median ratios 0.76-0.80, engine p95 0.5 ms (per frame 1 ms), 0 tiles painted after the first pass, 27 slabs restored.
- webkit-laptop-1440: ratio 0.92, p95 0.25 ms.
- dpr-2 latency p50: 14 ms.

Full gate on integrate: tsc for ink and web, vitest ink 71 and web 254, config_api pytest 21, biome on packages and apps/web/src/ink, content, e2e and playwright.config.ts. I left biome on the whole repo out of the gate: it fails at apps/web/src/cards/fsrs.test.ts:146 (useLiteralKeys, S10's file, already on the shared tip). Reported to seg10 in 20261117T031916.

Risk: on dpr-2 WebKit the ink-shown/hidden ratio fell from about 0.87 to 0.76-0.80. Without decode(), the WPE build decodes a restored picture when it first paints, and only frames with the ink shown pay for that. Safari on the iPad decodes large images off the main thread. CI passed.
